preregistration.hypothesis: The sedenion associator tensor discriminates THEMIS-A magnetopause crossings better than the associator of a random unital XOR-graded twist on the same basis.
preregistration.control_family: n_draws uniformly random unital twists sigma: {1..15}^2 -> {+1,-1} with sigma(0,.) = sigma(.,0) = +1, each scored through SparseCubicTensor::from_twist on the identical stratified subsample; plus n_scrambles exact-support sign scrambles of the CD tensor (seeds seed..seed+n_scrambles-1, so seed 42 reproduces C-1632) as the lower rung.
preregistration.falsifier: Canonical AUC at or below the 97.5th percentile of the random-twist AUC ensemble (tail probability >= 0.025).
preregistration.seed_policy: ChaCha8; twist d uses seed 42 + (d+1)*0x9E3779B97F4A7C15 (wrapping); subsample keeps every positive and each negative with probability 0.05 from ChaCha8(seed XOR file_id*0x9E3779B97F4A7C15)

decision: twist-specific: canonical AUC 0.8274 exceeds the random-twist 97.5th percentile 0.5922 (tail probability 0.0010)
